output.headline: Heartland Dental is a dental-only strategic that closed all four of its deals, ranks first on the priority list, and pays near upper-quartile multiples.
output.differentiator: It has more deals in the target's own sub-sector than any other buyer on the priority list, and all closed. Its 15.3x median paid sits just under the comparable upper quartile. [T:record, K:closed_share, V:comps]
output.why_them: Dental specialist; closes every deal; pays near upper quartile

acquirer_overview.title: A dental-only strategic buyer with a clean closing record
points: Strategic buyer with dental as its home sub-sector. All 4 deals are in dental; none are in adjacent provider sub-sectors. [B:buyer, T:record]
All 4 deals closed between 2017 and 2022, all as control deals. Median deal size is $75M. [K:closed_share, K:control_share, T:record]
Company profile and buyer revenue were not researched, so its scale is unconfirmed. [V:synergy]

strategic_fit_thesis.title: The target sits squarely in its dental buying pattern
points: Share of deals in the target's sub-sector is the strongest factor in its likelihood. Margin fit and close rate are modest positives. [S:sector_share, S:margin_fit, S:close_rate_s]
Cost synergies and scale drove 2 of 4 deals, against 21% of all deals in the file, so this is a distinct motive. [M:cost_synergies]
It has one Southeast deal, Valley Dental Network (2021). Geographic expansion tags 4 of 4 deals but also 90% of the file, so it does not set it apart. [D:MA-2021-0356, M:geographic_expansion]

precedent_activity.title: Four dental precedents, from $16M to $409M
points: Madison Dental Solutions: $119M management buyout, 2022, at 16.1x EV/EBITDA. [D:MA-2022-0084]
Eastern Orthodontics: $409M management buyout, 2021, at 16.0x. Valley Dental Network: $31M recapitalization, 2021, Southeast, at 10.7x. [D:MA-2021-0434, D:MA-2021-0356]
Only 1 of its 4 deals falls in the comparable size band of $40M-$160M. [K:size_band]

valuation_context.title: Its 15.3x median supports pricing near the 75th percentile
points: 63 comparable deals show 11.0x at the lower quartile, 13.7x at the median and 15.4x at the upper quartile. [V:comps]
The target's 18.0% margin is above the comparable median of 12.4%, which supports upper-quartile pricing. [V:comps, X:target]
Its own median paid is 15.3x. Cost-synergy headroom is $5M-$9M; buyer revenue is not researched, so capacity to pay needs confirming. [V:comps, V:synergy]

risk_flags.title: Thin recent activity
risk_flags.concern: Only one deal since 2022, and its last deal was in 2022.
risk_flags.mitigant: All 4 deals closed, and recency is only a slight factor against it.
risk_flags.reality: Appetite looks proven but not current; confirm it is still buying. [K:recent, S:recency, K:closed_share]

risk_flags.title: Capacity unverified
risk_flags.concern: Buyer revenue is not researched, and only 1 of 4 deals is in the comparable size band.
risk_flags.mitigant: Median deal of $75M is close to the target's $80M EV; synergy headroom is $5M-$9M.
risk_flags.reality: Fit on size looks reasonable; ability to fund is unconfirmed. [V:synergy, T:record, K:size_band]

risk_flags.title: Low Southeast precedent price
risk_flags.concern: Its only Southeast deal was struck at 10.7x, below the 11.0x comparable lower quartile.
risk_flags.mitigant: Its median paid across all deals is 15.3x.
risk_flags.reality: The target's margin supports upper-quartile pricing; the buyer must accept it. [D:MA-2021-0356, V:comps]

conviction.rationale: Four deals in the target's own sub-sector, none in adjacent ones, one deal in the target's region, and a first-place position among the highest-scored buyers after review. [C:conviction, T:record, R:rank]
